title: File:Evanescence live at the O2 Dome London 141122 - 52507689546.jpg
desc:
Evanescence topped a double-headliner bill (with Within Temptation) at the O2 and used it to showcase a couple of new songs and a brisk run through their back catalogue. Amy lee was on top form vocally and at the piano, ably supported by her band:
Troy McLawhorn – guitars
Tim McCord – guitars
Will H
